name: asah-prediction-models

review.citation: Parekh A, et al. Clinical prediction models for aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage: a systematic review update. J NeuroIntervent Surg 2023.

question: Clinical prediction models for functional outcome after aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage
criteria_source: Transcribed from the review's Methods ('Types of study to be included' and 'Exclusion'); PDF supplied by an author.

criteria.population: Adult patients presenting with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage (aSAH)
criteria.intervention_or_exposure: A clinical prediction model developed (or validated) with multivariable statistical or machine learning methods, based on the independent effects of at least two predictor variables
criteria.outcomes: Functional outcome, mainly the Glasgow Outcome Scale (GOS) or modified Rankin Scale (mRS), at discharge, 3, 6 or 12 months after ictus
criteria.study_designs: Studies that develop new prediction models or validate existing ones
exclusion: Models for secondary outcome events or complications (e.g. angiographic vasospasm, delayed cerebral ischemia, cerebral infarction, seizures, hydrocephalus)
Grading schemes based on expert opinion or linear regression
Prediction models for traumatic SAH or perimesencephalic SAH
Models using only a subset of patients presenting with aSAH
Predictors, particularly biomarkers, not measured as part of routine clinical care

included_source: Table 1 (22 studies, 29 models): references 1 and 8-28, mapped to PMIDs via the Europe PMC reference list; ref 1 (Jaja 2018, SAHIT, BMJ) found by title search.
search_query: (subarachnoid hemorrhage[tiab] OR subarachnoid haemorrhage[tiab]) AND aneurysm*[tiab] AND (predict*[tiab] OR prognos*[tiab]) AND (model*[tiab] OR score*[tiab] OR nomogram*[tiab]) AND 2010:2022[dp]
